title: Event if the player escape the battle

posts.author: MatixPon
posts.body:
Hello, this is the first time I'm writing here and I'm addressing a problem. I'm currently creating a fan-made game on RPG Maker MV, I've made a battle system, set “Can escape” along with an event. This event is “If Escaped: Ballon Animation (wait) on this event”. When I test the game and when I escape during the fight, this event triggers, but I can't move the character.
If there is a solution, please let me know.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Does the event stop after the escape part? Is there something else running? Does that happen on an empty map. Did you check your common events? Does that happen with your plugins OFF?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
than remove "wait" as "wait" in moveroute stops all event till it's over,
removing that counts for the current event only I think and not the player.
else there should be a checkbox for it.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Just use
Set Movement Route
on this event, let it do something than following. Do not check the wait checkbox though.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: Mine I set it up to "Set movement route this event: One step backwards. Skip if cannot move" then wait (60) frames. That has the event back up and also not move for a little.
